description: Utilities for WebSocket server functionality. Enables accepting WebSocket connections, sending and receiving messages, and managing WebSocket sessions.

instructions.description: Sets up a route for the HTTP server.
instructions.name: Setup route

parameters.description: Function to be called when the route is matched

handlerTemplate.description:
Handles incoming HTTP request with automatic body parsing.

The request body is parsed based on HTTP `Content-Type` header. The parser can handle JSON payloads, URL-encoded forms, plain text, bytes and multipart form data. Note that due to buffer size limits multipart payloads are not parsed immediately, instead a pending form data resource is provided.

The function receives a resource to HTTP request that expects a response.
handlerTemplate.name: Handle request

parameters.name: request
parameters.valueDescription: {     cookies: array,     headers: object.record,     method: "GET" | "POST" | "PUT" | "DELETE" | "PATCH" | "OPTIONS" | "HEAD",     params: object.record,     query: object.record,     path: string,     version: string,     body: any }

parameters.name: onHttpRequest

parameters.description: Function to be called when the WebSocket connection is established

handlerTemplate.description: Handles new WebSocket connection establishment. Called when a client successfully upgrades the HTTP connection to a WebSocket connection.
handlerTemplate.name: Handle WebSocket connection

parameters.name: onWebSocketConnection

parameters.description: Function to be called when the route is matched

handlerTemplate.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages from clients. Called when a message is received over the WebSocket connection. The function receives the message content and the current actor state.
handlerTemplate.name: Handle WebSocket message

parameters.name: onWebSocketMessage

parameters.description: Function to be called when the WebSocket is closed

handlerTemplate.description: Handles WebSocket disconnection events. Called when the WebSocket connection is closed, either by the client or due to an error. The function receives the disconnection reason and the current actor state.
handlerTemplate.name: Handle WebSocket disconnection

parameters.name: onWebSocketDisconnection

parameters.description: Function to be called when the actor receives a new message
parameters.name: onMessage

parameters.description: Function to be called when the actor receives a new request
parameters.name: onRequest

instructions.description: In order to communicate over a WebSocket, the HTTP connection needs to be upgraded to a WebSocket. Use this action in request handler in WebSocket service to upgrade the connection to allow further communication over WebSocket.
instructions.name: Accept WebSocket

instructions.description: Sends a message over a WebSocket. If no name is provided, the scoped WebSocket will be used. If no WebSocket is found the action will fail.
instructions.name: Send message

parameters.description: Message to send, automatically converts to JSON if an object or array is provided
parameters.name: message

instructions.description: Sends a closing message and terminates a connection consuming WebSocket resource. If no name is provided, the scoped WebSocket will be used. If no WebSocket is found the action will fail.
